items.title: UWM Holdings Corporation Announces $2.05 Billion Strategic Capital Partnership with the Ishbia Family and Oaktree
items.summary: Transaction provides significant permanent capital, strengthens UWM’s balance sheet, enhances liquidity and positions the nation’s leading mortgage lender to continue investing through the cycle UWM Holdings Corporation (NYSE: UWMC) (“UWMC” or the “Company”), the publicly traded indirect parent of United Wholesale Mortgage (“UWM”), today announced a $2.05 billion strategic capital partnership with the Ishbia Family via their new family investment vehicle, SFS Group Capital, LLC (“SFS”) and Oaktree Capital Management, L.P. (“Oaktree”) to fortify UWM’s balance sheet and position the Company for continued long-term success at a time when many competitors are pulling back. The initial investment was made in the form of preferred equity together with warrants. items.title: UWM Holdings Corporation Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.summary: Loan Origination Volume of $39.7 Billion. Total loan origination volume was $39.7 billion for the second quarter 2026. items.title: SFS Holdings Corp. Terminates 10b5-1 Plan
items.summary: UWMC (NYSE: UWMC) announced that Mat Ishbia, as controlling owner of SFS Holdings Corp., has terminated its Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The trading plan was part of strategy implemented in 2025 in response to investor feedback requesting increased public float and trading liquidity. With the 10b5-1 plans having successfully increased liquidity of the stock such that average daily volume is now over 16 million shares and having increased float by over 135 million shares since June 2025, SFS terminated the plan effective Friday, May 8, the first day of UWMC’s open trading window since December 2025. SFS Holdings remains UWMC’s largest shareholder, with approximately 1.3 billion shares and believes it has done its part as the controlling shareholder to respond to the requests of the investment community by selling shares without regard to the stock price since June 2025.
